brief: DEEPER: pre-launch marketing site for a real-time multiplayer conversation game
outcome: rejected by the user. Read as print rather than as the product: 2px corners, hairline rules, a single accent rationed to one button, and a page too sparse to carry a product with no social proof. Nothing wrong with the rules, wrong brief answered.

theme_axes: dark / grotesk-sans / warm, glow-lit, generous radii
vibe: the lamp is on, two people at a table at 1am
enrichment: E1 real texture assets (grain + three glow PNGs) + E2 illustrated game states drawn from the shipping app's own strings
nav: N9 Edge-aligned minimal, plus a native disclosure on small screens
brief: same brief, plus: more pages, how-to-play content, pictures where they help
outcome: shipped. Radii matched to the app's own scale (8/14/20/28), the accent kept to one hue with violet confined to gradients and glows, gradient text removed from the hero after the first draft reintroduced it, and the closing panel de-centred because a centred box of stacked buttons is the shape every generated landing page converges on.

macrostructure: n/a — copy corrections, no layout change
brief: site copy audit after two false claims were found
outcome: Removed three invented capability claims: guests playing in a browser, installing nothing to join, and questions being drawn at random. Added an audit gate coupled to app.json so the web-client claim cannot come back without a web target. Also removed three randomness claims after finding getQuestions was deterministic. The honesty gate looked for invented metrics and could not see an invented capability; that is why the new gate is coupled to the build config instead of to a phrase list.
